channel.title: Pier & Point · J. David Gladstone Institutes
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for J. David Gladstone Institutes (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · J. David Gladstone Institutes: Gladstone's history page says J. David Gladstone, a…
item.description: Gladstone's history page says J. David Gladstone, a shopping-center developer, died in 1971 and "the estate established Gladstone Laboratories in 1979"; the institutes are named for him but he was not their founder in person. Source: https://gladstone.org/about/history; https://gladstone.org/news/gladstone-expands-research-footprint-105000-square-feet-new-laboratory-space.

item.title: Correction · J. David Gladstone Institutes: Long 'At a glance' values were cut to the fact itself…
item.description: Long 'At a glance' values were cut to the fact itself (or 'Sources differ'); the disputes, quoted excerpts and hedging moved to this record's open questions, with every source still named. No change to the record's status or shape. Source: Pier & Point's own text edit.

item.title: Correction · J. David Gladstone Institutes: J. David Gladstone Institutes now uses its Assessor…
item.description: J. David Gladstone Institutes now uses its Assessor lot lines. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lot 8709008.

item.title: Correction · J. David Gladstone Institutes: The Gladstone Institutes building's December 2004…
item.description: The Gladstone Institutes building's December 2004 dedication date came from a UCSF story that could not be re-read; its completion is now dated 2004, as Gladstone's own history page gives it. Source: https://gladstone.org/about/history.

item.title: Correction · J. David Gladstone Institutes: The record said a roughly 105,000 sq ft, $160M…
item.description: The record said a roughly 105,000 sq ft, $160M expansion at 1650 Owens was announced in 2023. SF YIMBY (Feb 16, 2023) says the six-story building would grow from 200,000 to 275,000 sq ft, about 75,000 sq ft, with construction expected late 2024 to 2026. The 105,000 sq ft figure belongs to Gladstone's March 2026 lease of new lab space at 1450 Owens Street, opening early 2027 (Gladstone news release, Mar 25, 2026). Whether the 1650 Owens expansion was built is not confirmed. The record now describes Gladstone as an independent nonprofit in academic partnership with UCSF, citing SF YIMBY and Gladstone, and the aerial photo's caption no longer says 'from a departing flight'. Source: SF YIMBY, 2023-02-16 (https://sfyimby.com/2023/02/gladstone-expansion-announced-for-1650-owens-street-in-mission-bay-san-francisco.html); Gladstone Institutes, 2026-03-25 (https://gladstone.org/news/gladstone-expands-research-footprint-105000-square-feet-new-laboratory-space).

item.title: Added · J. David Gladstone Institutes: SF Department of Building Inspection permit #200208194343…
item.description: SF Department of Building Inspection permit #200208194343 gives a revised construction-cost valuation of $26.4M for the original 6-story building at 1650 Owens St (initial filed estimate $14M). No Gladstone- or UCSF-stated project budget was found. Source: DataSF Building Permits, permit 200208194343 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=200208194343).

item.title: Milestone · J. David Gladstone Institutes: A roughly $160M expansion at 1650 Owens… (Feb 2023)
item.description: A roughly $160M expansion at 1650 Owens Street, growing the six-story building from 200,000 to 275,000 sq ft (about 75,000 sq ft added), is announced; construction was then expected to start in late 2024 and finish by 2026, and whether it was built is not confirmed (Feb 2023). Source: San Francisco YIMBY, 2023-02.

item.title: Complete · J. David Gladstone Institutes: Gladstone completes its new six-story, 200,000… (~2004)
item.description: Gladstone completes its new six-story, 200,000 sq ft Mission Bay research building (Gladstone's history page gives 2004); the December 2004 dedication rests on a UCSF news story that could not be re-read in October 2026 (~2004). Source: Gladstone Institutes; UC San Francisco, 2004-12.

item.title: Under construction · J. David Gladstone Institutes: The Gladstone Institute's new… (~Nov 2003)
item.description: The Gladstone Institute's new Mission Bay building, across Owens Street from the neighboring Building 23B parking structure, is reported 'now under construction' in a UC Regents budget item for that garage, which notes UCSF's agreement to accommodate the Institute with 240 parking spaces (~Nov 2003). Source: Regents of the University of California, 2003-11-06.
